name: Foundry Floor

acceptance.statement: This 62-model pack combines the staged interior and campus deliveries. Its source pins, licence identities and downloaded bytes have been checked together. Those checks do not establish the owner’s visual or simulation acceptance; the pack stays in production until that review.
acceptance.source: Sealed pack.json source pins and credits, data/assets.json, data/campus-assets.json when present, and the licence text

licenseScope: CC0-1.0 covers authored asset content only, to the extent of the owner’s rights. Kiln and any software that opens these files retain their own licenses.
licenceNote: The licence text comes from the sealed Foundry Floor scene pack. It names every model, its saved revision, author attribution and the SHA-256 of its GLB, and is published here unchanged.

conventions.frame: Metres. Interior assets use +X forward, +Y up and +Z right. Campus assets retain the coordinate frames of their source models.
conventions.lod: 43 models declare optional MSFT_lod tiers. A loader that ignores this extension draws the default detailed form; an LOD-aware application can select the separate lower tiers.
conventions.hidden: Two models carry parts the scene hides when it loads them: the FOUP (waferStack) and the level section module (raisedFloor, ffuPlenum, cutFaceCaps_raisedFloor, cutFaceCaps_ffuWhite, cutFaceCaps_ffuHousing). They are part of the file, and a plain viewer draws them.
conventions.materials: No model uses a texture; colours are material factors. The pack’s accent colours are invented for readability and are not any maker’s livery.
conventions.clips: Animation clips carry no loop flags; the scene decides what loops.
conventions.source: Interior conventions come from data/assets.json; every figure on this page was read from its sealed GLB. Campus assets retain their source conventions.

downloads.compatibility: Standard glTF 2.0. 43 models declare optional MSFT_lod tiers. A loader that ignores this extension draws the default detailed form; an LOD-aware application can select the separate lower tiers. Engine import and runtime behavior must be checked for the chosen file; see the Blender/Unity handoff guide for its exact tested cases.
